charge_port.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV and evspecs.org list CCS; US/Canada cars assumed CCS1 (Combo 1); no Rolls-Royce NA page read.

supercharger_access.notes: GuideAuto relaying the Oct 2023 BMW NA announcement: CCS-equipped MINI Cooper SE and Rolls-Royce Spectre get Supercharger access (early 2025) with an adapter. Not re-confirmed on a Rolls-Royce page.

wheels.notes: Spectre: 22 x 8.5 front / 22 x 9.5 rear aluminum, P255/45R22 and P285/40R22. (US page; Canadian cars assumed the same.)
Spectre: the Spectre Enhancement Package lists 23 in Wing Spoke wheels (2025 page). Carried from the 2025 Spectre page, no page for this exact year opened. (US page; Canadian cars assumed the same.)
